candidates.change_summary: Replace the addition to imBalances[to] with subtraction, causing supplies to decrease beneficiary balances instead of increase.
Replace updating imBalances[to] with updating imBalances[msg.sender], so credits are assigned to the caller rather than the specified beneficiary.
Replace creditsIssued with a constant 0 when updating imBalances[to], so supplies do not change balances.
Replace call to savings.depositSavings with depositSavings to a different beneficiary (msg.sender), changing creditsIssued semantics if savings uses caller/beneficiary.
Remove the reentrancy guard require check, allowing reentrant calls that can alter imBalances during supplyTokenTo.
Change the require in _nonReentrantBefore to allow reentrancy by checking equality to _ENTERED instead of inequality, effectively inverting the protection.
